recipe.visualDefinition: A tri-tonal grid-based composition featuring a vertical portrait on the left, a solid color block on the right containing a tracklist, and a horizontal header bar with large-scale display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the textured concrete background and flat primary color blocks.
Alignment of the header text with the right-hand color panel edge.
Interaction between the subject's posture and the vertical division of the frame.
Repetition of drop-shadowed sans-serif typography across different scales.
coreInvariants: Primary red and blue color blocks
Heavy drop shadows on all text elements
Concrete wall texture in the photographic section

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length portrait positioned in the left two-thirds of the frame, leaning against a textured wall.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, lime-green display name in the top blue header bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left header, moves across the main name, drops down to the portrait, and finishes on the right-side tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized through the flat color blocks to provide breathing room for dense text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Red (right panel) and Cobalt Blue (top header).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lime Green (main title) and White (secondary text).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow (paint splatter on wall) and Cyan (bottom track items).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all blocks with high value contrast between text and backgrounds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights, colors, and scales to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence of the main title.
Provides the mid-century grotesque feel for the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen background. The left 60% is a photo of a man in a black jacket leaning against a light gray concrete wall with a yellow paint splatter. The top 15% is a solid cobalt blue bar. The right 40% (below the blue bar) is a solid vibrant red block.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large lime-green condensed sans-serif text in the blue bar with a dark blue drop shadow. Add a vertical list of white condensed sans-serif text in the red block, centered, with dark blue drop shadows. Use cyan for the final two items in the list.

verificationChecks: Are the drop shadows hard-edged and consistent in direction?
Is the color palette limited to the specified primary tones?
Is the portrait positioned on the left against a concrete texture?

adjustableVariables: Width of the red side panel
Height of the blue header bar
Color of the main title text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the lime green text is legible against the blue background.
Ensure the drop shadows do not blur into the background.
Verify the concrete texture looks like a physical wall, not a digital pattern.
Confirm the vertical alignment of the right-side text list.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured environmental portrait with bold, primary-colored geometric blocks and heavy, drop-shadowed condensed sans-serif typography for a 1960s pop aesthetic.
